description:
Earn commission promoting premium tattoo aftercare products with Ancient Ink.

About Our Brand and Products

Ancient Ink creates premium tattoo care designed to help tattoos heal cleanly and stay vibrant over time.

Tattoos are permanent art, but most aftercare products on the market rely on outdated formulas built around heavy petroleum and filler ingredients. Ancient Ink was created to offer a more intentional approach to tattoo wellness.

Our products are designed to support the entire tattoo journey, including:

• Skin preparation before tattooing
• Healing support during the aftercare phase
• Long-term care to help tattoos maintain their clarity and vibrancy

Each formula uses biologically supportive ingredients the skin already recognizes, including vegetable charcoal, witch hazel, turmeric, aloe, and restorative botanical oils. These ingredients help calm irritation, support proper healing, and protect the skin without suffocating it with heavy occlusives.

All Ancient Ink products are manufactured in the United States under GMP-certified standards and developed specifically for people who care about how their tattoos heal and age.


What Makes Us Different

Purpose-Built Tattoo Care
Ancient Ink isn’t a generic skincare brand. Our products are designed specifically for tattooed skin and the healing process that follows tattooing.

Clean, Functional Ingredients
We prioritize ingredients that actively support skin health instead of relying on petroleum-based formulas that simply sit on the skin.

Key ingredients include:

• Vegetable charcoal
• Witch hazel
• Turmeric
• Aloe
• Botanical oils and plant extracts

These ingredients help calm the skin, support healing, and maintain tattoo clarity.

A Complete Tattoo Care System
Our products are designed to work together to support skin through preparation, healing, and long-term tattoo care.

Authentic Brand Story
Ancient Ink is rooted in respect for tattoo culture and the belief that tattoos deserve thoughtful care.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Ancient Ink affiliates earn commission every time someone purchases using their referral link or discount code.

Affiliate partners receive:

• Competitive commission on every sale
• A personalized referral link and creator discount code
• Performance-based opportunities for top creators

Because tattoo care products are used throughout the healing process and for long-term maintenance, affiliates can benefit from repeat customer purchases over time.

Top-performing partners may also receive:

• Product seeding opportunities
• Exclusive promotions
• Collaboration opportunities with the brand

Our goal is to build long-term relationships with creators who introduce their audiences to better tattoo care.

How to Promote Us

Ancient Ink performs best when creators share authentic content around tattoos, skin care, and personal experiences.

Creators often promote the brand through:

• Tattoo healing journeys
• Tattoo care tips and education
• Product integrations in lifestyle content
• Personal tattoo stories and experiences
• Studio or artist recommendations

Sharing your honest experience with tattoo care is the most effective way to introduce Ancient Ink to your audience.

Other Information

Who This Program Is For

We welcome creators of all types, including:

• Tattoo enthusiasts and collectors
• Lifestyle influencers with tattooed audiences
• Skin care and wellness creators
• Tattoo artists and studios
• Creators documenting their tattoo journeys

You do not need to be a professional tattoo artist to join the program. If your audience is interested in tattoos, skin care, or personal expression, Ancient Ink is a great fit.

Fast Application Process

Affiliate applications are reviewed quickly so creators can start promoting the brand as soon as possible.

Product Seeding Opportunities

Qualified creators may receive products to test and share with their audiences.

Ancient Ink is building a community of creators who believe tattoos deserve thoughtful care and long-term protection.

If that resonates with you, we invite you to apply and become an Ancient Ink affiliate.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Ancient Ink! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

Scope of Work

You will share Ancient Ink content and your affiliate link to earn commission and perks. 

**Content Expectations **

When posting Ancient Ink content on social media, you must tag us (@OfficialAncientInk) or set Officialancientink as a collaborator on your posts

You must avoid medical claims, including:

❌ “Treats acne”
 ❌ “Heals skin conditions”
 ❌ “Clinically proven” 

Approved Language Examples

  • “Skin-friendly formula”

  • “Clean, vegan ingredients”

  • “Designed to support healthy-looking skin”

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: affiliate@ancientink.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to affiliate@ancientink.com for support.
